description: Na₄Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.59 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.82 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.97 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.92 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Co atoms to form corner-sharing ONa₂Co₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and two Co atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MgCo₂ trigonal bipyramids.
